The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `8080` (see `PlaywrightBuilder.PlaywrightPort`)
- Entrypoint: `/bin/sh -c`
- Command: `npx -y playwright@$(sed --quiet 's/.*\"driverVersion\": *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' ms-playwright/.docker-info) run-server --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080`
- Wait strategy: Waits until a message matching `Listening on ws://.*:8080/` is logged.
